sources.inspection_basis: New independent visual review of complete relevant PDF pages in this resolution run; not a relabelled reuse of the earlier agent pass.

claims.fact: The selected description is the four-dimensional nonsupersymmetric unified so(10) theory. Intermediate subgroups and their decomposed fields are alternative regimes, not extra simultaneous gauge factors or multiplets. Gauge connections are implicit in so(10). No global form is inferred.

claims.locator: SectionIIA pp2 Eqs1-4;SectionIIC p3 Eq7;AppendixA p14 EqsA1-A7
claims.fact: The scalar containers are one45H represented by antisymmetric phi_ij, and one complex self-dual126H represented by Sigma. The source mass-matrix coordinate vector is( phi,Sigma*,Sigma ) of dimension297=45+126+126. Thus phi supplies45 real components, Sigma252 real components. The dependent conjugateSigma* is not a second complex scalar container. The atlas counts one real adjoint module and one underlying-real126 module.

claims.locator: SectionIVA p11 Eq17 and footnote15;p12 paragraph following Eq18
claims.fact: The full45H+126H+10H model has independently allowed10H and10H* Yukawa couplings. The source contrasts this with the alternative real-component10H condition, which identifies the terms. The target complex10 entry therefore uses one unconstrained complex scalar10 container, which is two real-module copies because the vector10 irrep is real type. No real10 or120H alternative is silently added.

claims.locator: SectionIVA p11 opening paragraph before Eq17;SectionI p1 renormalizable16F16F126H* interaction
claims.fact: The paper explicitly discusses the model whose Higgs content is just45H and126H, coupled to spinorial16F through16F f12616F126H*. Its objection is an unrealistic Yukawa spectrum/mixing, not an unspecified gauge-matter completion. Since phenomenological viability is not an atlas intake requirement, the existing scalar-sector source record can be completed as this explicitly discussed full model with the ordinary fermion baseline. This does not append10H from the separately discussed extension.

claims.locator: SectionIVA pp11-12 SM flavour/mass-matrix discussion and Eq18;SectionIVB p13 asymptotic-freedom paragraph b=-12
claims.fact: The source uses the ordinary Standard Model family sector unified in16F, rather than a new freely variable family number. The concrete atlas member is three families; this is explicit inherited-SM metadata, not a literal printed3x16 table. Independent count cross-check for the source complex10 full model: T(10)=1,T(16)=2,T(45)=8,T(126)=35,C2(adj)=8; b=-(11/3)*8+(1/6)*8+(1/3)*35+(1/3)*1+(2/3)*2*n16=-16+(4/3)*n16. The printed b=-12 gives n16=3. The same ordinary16F baseline occurs in the just45+126 discussion. This calculation checks source multiplicity, not anomaly cancellation or viability.

claims.locator: SectionI p1 andSectionIVA p11 16F16F126H* Yukawa contraction;SectionIVA p12 Eq18
claims.fact: Represent each ordinary unified chiral16F family as one left-handed Weyl field, containing the left-handed Standard Model fields and conjugates of right-handed fields, including a conjugate neutrino. The opposite spacetime chirality would require conjugating the full gauge irrep. We fix the gauge-spinor orientation explicitly below; dependent Hermitian conjugates in the Yukawa Lagrangian are not independent additional16F rows.

claims.locator: SectionIIB p3 standardY=TR3+TBL,Z=-4TR3+6TBL;TableII p4 standard5x1Z column;SectionIVA p11 Yukawa16F16F126H*
claims.fact: Choose BourbakiD5 alpha1=e1-e2,alpha2=e2-e3,alpha3=e3-e4,alpha4=e4-e5,alpha5=e4+e5; standardA4 usesalpha1..alpha4 andZ=-2*sum(e_i). Sym^2(16) contains126 with highest2omega4=[0,0,0,2,0]; its SU5singletZ+10 agrees with TableII and16F16F126H*. Vector10=omega1=[1,0,0,0,0],adjoint45=omega2=[0,1,0,0,0].
